scientific_integrity: Analytic proof reconstructs surface Jacobian, spherical beta moments, Gaussian covariance representation, order-reversing axis weights, equality and flattening limits. Eight numerical ellipsoid tests and exact identities corroborate but do not prove the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Full-dimensional Euclidean ellipsoids, dimension at least two, normalized Euclidean surface and volume measures, squared distances only. Lower constant is unattained. No convex-order claim for all powers or all convex bodies. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp surface-to-volume second-moment bounds for Euclidean ellipsoids
